historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved a professional services agreement with Richard Schadt Associates, landscape architects, to design bleachers for Galvez Playfield near Hudson Avenue and Lane Street, and a second to design, make and install its play structure, in place of a steel play sculpture earlier commissioned from Aristides Demetrios.
At the joint request of Bayview-Hunters Point community groups, the Recreation and Park Commission named the Galvez facility the Youngblood-Coleman Playground, for two late residents of the district.

The Recreation and Park Department and the Redevelopment Agency were to dedicate the Youngblood-Coleman Playground, formerly Galvez, on Saturday, June 16. Designed by Richard Schadt, it had a lighted baseball diamond, a softball diamond, a recreation center, athletic courts, play apparatus and a large sculpture.
